all_iterate_position_check: Source centers of E_i lie in I_H: a source infinity point outside I_H maps regularly to q at infinity and cannot yield an affine generic image. A finite inverse valuation of E_i must also have center in I_H, because otherwise its center maps to q and stays q, never I_H. Every D_i and forward image has only infinity q; leading homogeneous equations are nonzero at every point of I_H. Consequently ord_Ei f=-b_i deg f for all these factors simultaneously.

The all-Keller degree-one transport and regular q give degree H(C)=d deg C. actual_iterate_omitted_prime: H^n sends the generic DVR of w to E_i, and H sends E_i to the affine curve D_i.
